name: Cochlear Nerve Deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Radiologic and audiologic diagnostic criteria for cochlear nerve deficiency

criteria.description: Absence of cochlear nerve on high-resolution MRI
Severe to profound sensorineural hearing loss confirmed by audiometry
Absent or hypoplastic internal auditory canal on imaging

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of absent cochlear nerve on MRI plus severe to profound sensorineural hearing loss
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on high-resolution MRI and audiologic evaluation.

searchTerms: missing hearing nerve on brain scan

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe to profound sensorineural hearing loss
searchTerms: severe hearing loss from inner ear damage

common.symptomName: Absent or hypoplastic internal auditory canal
searchTerms: small or missing ear canal on imaging
narrow or absent ear canal bone

common.symptomName: Poor speech development due to hearing impairment
searchTerms: speech problems due to hearing loss
hearing loss in one or both ears
problems identifying where sounds come from

occasional.notes: May present as balance issues or delayed motor milestones

rare.symptomName: Associated inner ear malformations (e.g., cochlear hypoplasia)
searchTerms: inner ear malformations like small cochlea

rare.symptomName: Developmental delay unrelated to hearing loss
searchTerms: delayed overall development not caused by hearing
drooping on one side of face

imaging: High-resolution MRI showing absent or hypoplastic cochlear nerve
CT scan showing absent or narrow internal auditory canal
genetic: No specific gene identified; may be sporadic or associated with syndromic conditions
other: Audiometric testing confirming severe to profound sensorineural hearing loss

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of cochlear nerve on imaging
Abnormal auditory brainstem responses with preserved otoacoustic emissions
Structural abnormalities of cochlea on imaging

redFlags: No response to conventional hearing aids
Severe to profound sensorineural hearing loss in infancy
references: Sennaroglu L, Bajin MD. Classification and current management of inner ear malformations. Balkan Med J. 2017;34(5):397-411.
Fayad JN, Linthicum FH Jr. Multichannel cochlear implants: relation of histopathology to performance. Laryngoscope. 2006;116(7):1310-1320.
